entries.section: MTD VAT Return in ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini
entries.summary: Not through the hosted connector.
entries.text: Not through the hosted connector. bookSections.name: documentInfo
bookSections.description: gl-cor:documentInfo — Metadata about this set of books

bookSections.description: gl-cor:entityInformation + gl-bus:organizationInformation — Who this book belongs to

bookSections.name: directors
bookSections.description: diya-gl: extension — Company directors and their shareholdings (Company Accounts only). Used to populate Companysecretary.xlsx sheets.

bookSections.name: employees
bookSections.description: diya-gl: extension — Employees on payroll. Used to populate Payslips.xlsx. Includes directors paid via PAYE.

bookSections.name: accounts
bookSections.description: Chart of accounts. Maps to gl-cor:account tuples. Organised by journal for spreadsheet column mapping.

bookSections.name: openingBalances
bookSections.description: diya-gl: extension — The trial balance brought forward, reverse-engineered today from an opening journal by buildOpeningBalance(); this table lets a book state it directly. Every figure is positive except the bank balances, the trade debtors, the trade creditors and the long-term debtors, which a book may state below nil (an overdrawn account, or a payment made before the invoice it settles); the balance sheet applies its own sign.

bookSections.name: stock
bookSections.description: diya-gl: extension — Opening and closing stock, and the physical count taken at each. materialsPercent is the share of net sales that is direct materials; the Stock sheet's bought and sold columns stay at zero without it.

bookSections.name: debtors
bookSections.description: diya-gl: extension — Named trade debtors at the opening or closing balance sheet date.

bookSections.name: creditors
bookSections.description: diya-gl: extension — Named trade creditors at the opening or closing balance sheet date.

bookSections.name: fixedAssets
bookSections.description: diya-gl: extension — The fixed asset register: one entry per asset held at the opening balance sheet date or bought in the year. A capital allowance's balancing allowance on disposal reads taxWrittenDownValue, not accumulatedDepreciation, because the two schedules run at different rates. class is optional: the Basic Sole Trader and Taxi Driver Fixed Assets sheets carry a flat list with no asset-class blocks, unlike the Self Employed and Company Schedule.

bookSections.name: hpAgreements
bookSections.description: diya-gl: extension — Hire purchase agreements financing an asset over a fixed term. The HPfinance sheet works out its own monthly payment, capital and interest split from these fields.

bookSections.name: dividends
bookSections.description: diya-gl: extension — Dividends the board declared (Company Accounts only). The directors' report and the trial balance both read the declaration; the bank pays it in one or more instalments.

bookSections.name: members
bookSections.description: diya-gl: extension — The register of members (Company Accounts only). A member is not always a director; directors[] holds the officers.

bookSections.name: charges
bookSections.description: diya-gl: extension — Charges and debentures registered over the company's assets (Company Accounts only). Each secures a creditor falling due after more than one year.

bookSections.name: diya-gl:filings
bookSections.description: diya-gl: extension — The register of returns and accounts filed from this book: what was filed, for which period, when, the reference it was given, and the figures filed.

bookSections.name: diya-gl:statementBalances
bookSections.description: diya-gl: extension — The balances the bank's own statements show, keyed by the account code declared in accounts.bank.

bookSections.name: tax
bookSections.description: Tax rates and thresholds. Values from HMRC published rates for the period. Used by validate and generate commands. Derived from gl-taf tax concepts.

lineFields.name: diya-gl:bankCode
lineFields.description: diya-gl: extension — Bank receipt/payment code, matching the analysis columns of the bank account workbooks. Transfers between accounts carry the letter of the account on the other side: BB=current, BS=savings, BC=cash, BD=credit card. Receipt only: K=interest received. Payment only: W=net wages, B=bank charges, J=interest paid, DV=dividend, RP=HMRC PAYE, RT=HMRC corporation tax. Either side: DR=trade debtor, CR=trade creditor, LDR=long term debtor, LCR=long term creditor, RV=HMRC VAT, RC=HMRC CIS, DL=directors loan, X=bank contra item. BC on a bank line with no other account on the other side is the workbook's own opening balance.

lineFields.name: diya-gl:cisRate

lineFields.name: diya-gl:vatPeriodEnd

This is what makes a straddling entry representable: the line's postingDate sits in one accounting year, but its VAT is due on the return ending vatPeriodEnd.

lineFields.name: diya-gl:assetID

lineFields.name: diya-gl:memberID
